description: Generate a Vedic birth chart (Kundli) with planetary positions, house cusps, ascendant, nakshatras, and dignities. All calculations use Vedika Ephemeris (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa default). "kundli" returns the full chart. "planetary-positions" returns all 9 planets + Rahu/Ketu with sign, degree, house, nakshatra, retrograde status. "house-cusps" returns all 12 house boundaries. "ascendant" returns lagna details. Cost: $0.016-0.028/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

type.description: Chart type. kundli=full chart with houses+planets (default). birth-chart=basic positions. planetary-positions=all planets. house-cusps=12 house boundaries. ascendant=lagna only. birth-details=processed birth data.

name: vedika_birth_chart
